text:
Rafi Ko: hey team! first day here — hi from the Seattle office :wave: Im Rafi (he/him), formerly on infra automation. very much looking forward to the boba crawl and the meme channel. desk 2A-07 if anyone wants to drop by.
Talia Mendes: welcome Rafi!! :tada: boba crawl on Friday — we start at Tea & Sweets at 3pm. adding you to the RSVP. im your onboarding buddy, ping me for anything.
Eloise: welcome! also FYI badge pickup is with Facilities on floor 1 after 2pm.
Facilities: Badge ready for Rafi Ko. Show photo ID at desk 1 and well activate it.
Rafi Ko: thanks all 60A will swing by after lunch. also quick q — wheres the best plug for standing desks?
Noel: theres a spare standing converter on bench C, first come first serve. otherwise Ops can swap desks if needed.
Sammy: pro tip: office boba coupons live in the snack drawer by the kitchenette. i left a stash last week 609
Talia Mendes: OMG also youve been assigned the onboarding micro-quest to write a 2-line terrible Haiku about CI/CD. its tradition.
Rafi Ko: challenge accepted. first draft: "Pipelines hum low / tests flinch at dawn31D / deploys sip tea" 
Eloise: perfect, well frame it in the kitchen. :frame_with_picture: welcome again Rafi!
welcome-bot: Reminder: Join #memes and #boba-crawl to get calendar invites and sticker perks. New hire welcome orientation at 4:00 PM today.
Rafi Ko: thanks welcome-bot! see you all at orientation and maybe at Tea & Sweets later :boba:
